scenarios.scenario: The advisory planner honors advise.max_comments_per_pr: 0 by returning should_comment=false and writing no comment artifact.
The GitHub advisory workflow does not expose GH_TOKEN or github.token while executing checked-out Relia code.
The GitHub advisory workflow disables persisted checkout credentials before executing checked-out Relia code.
The GitHub advisory workflow seeds local advisory state from an existing hidden-marker comment before running the token-free planner.
The GitHub advisory workflow paginates and flattens all issue-comment pages before looking up the hidden advisory marker.
The GitHub advisory workflow publish step parses planner JSON directly and invokes gh without sourcing planner-controlled shell environment text while the Actions token is present.
The advisory planner still writes one hidden-marker PR advisory plan with real PR citations and skips unchanged diff fingerprints.
The advisory planner stays silent for covered_clean assessments when no prior advisory marker exists.
The advisory planner updates an existing advisory marker with a cleared covered-clean advisory instead of leaving stale warning text.
